description: A tiled gradient at device pixel ratio 2: lengths scale with the display.

florui.css: .box { width: 100px; height: 80px; border-radius: 12px; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #ff5a5f, #ffd166), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #ffffff, #1b1b2f); background-size: 40px 20px, 100% 100%; background-repeat: repeat-x, no-repeat; }

classification.reason: At device pixel ratio 2 the dithering stays at one level and the anti-aliased corners of the rounded box differ by up to 55 levels in 0.28% of the pixels, geometry an exact match.
